UNITS_WARNING: All quantities are IMAGE-DERIVED INDICES, not measurements. RDI is dimensionless (shape-from-shading min-max normalised to a hard-coded 500 nm assumption). Flagged regions are threshold crossings on that index, NOT electrically confirmed shunts. BPI is a mean Gaussian distance weight to Canny ridges, NOT a passivation fraction. The dVoc index is derived from an intensity-based PL surrogate - no photoluminescence was measured - so it is in arbitrary units, not millivolts. No nm-per-pixel calibration exists for this corpus: the FESEM pixel-size headers were destroyed by JPEG re-encoding in all 440 source images and no TIF originals survive.
